story.titleZh: 凯迪拉克为何此时决定用布德科夫斯基替换洛登
story.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克在夏休期突然宣布格拉姆·洛登即刻卸任车队领队，由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接任。CEO丹·托里斯承认换帅比预期更早，并称车队进入“新阶段”需要不同类型的领导。
story.originalTitle: Why Cadillac has decided to act now and replace Lowdon with Budkowski
story.summaryEn: Cadillac abruptly announced during the summer break that Graeme Lowdon has been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski. CEO Dan Towriss admitted the change came earlier than expected and said the team needs a different type of leadership for a "new phase".
detailZh: 凯迪拉克为何决定现在行动，用布德科夫斯基替换洛登
凯迪拉克F1首席执行官丹·托里斯表示，车队在“新阶段”需要不同类型的领导，但他承认这一变动来得比预期更早。那么，这支美国车队为何认为需要现在行动？
在赞德沃特荷兰大奖赛前一周多，F1世界从夏休中被突然惊醒。
英国时间下午3点，凯迪拉克决定时机已到，发布了一则令人震惊的公告：格拉姆·洛登已被马尔钦·布德科夫斯基即刻接替车队领队一职。
这则消息中有两点本身并不特别奇怪。对围场中许多人来说，一段时间以来已经很清楚：虽然广受欢迎的洛登在车队最初的组建阶段至关重要，但他不会长期担任车队领队。
凯迪拉克转向布德科夫斯基这样的人也不特别令人意外。这位在法国接受教育的波兰人在F1多个不同领域积累了经验：在Prost、法拉利和迈凯伦等车队担任技术职务，在国际汽联任职期间接触监管事务，随后又在阿尔派积累了领导经验。
凯迪拉克承认比计划更早
主要问题在于时机：为什么是现在，为什么这么早？
凯迪拉克在新闻稿和随后的媒体会上都强调这是一次“计划中的过渡”，但即便如此，时机也极不寻常。它发生在夏休期中段，而且凯迪拉克的首个F1赛季才进行到一半——换句话说，非常早。
“在F1，任何时候进行过渡，正如你们所知，都非常困难，”托里斯说，实际上等于承认这种干预没有完美的时机。
话虽如此，这位54岁的美国人确实承认，本意并不是这么早做出改变。是的，替换洛登一直是计划的一部分，但不一定是在这个时间点。
“格拉姆和我一直谈到，某个时候会有一次过渡，”他继续说道。“这个决定是我做的，我认为机会窗口非常狭窄。”
“当你审视我们正在建设的东西时，有机会打造一些新的、创新的东西。我不想做的是打造一些已经被做过的东西、一些老旧的东西，然后再试图改进它。所以我认为，这次变革的时机来得比预期更早。”
凯迪拉克承认这不是双方共同的决定，洛登在公告当天上午才被告知
这自然引出一个问题：凯迪拉克最初计划何时替换洛登？
然而，当Autosport询问最初的想法是否是在车队首个赛季结束时做出改变时，托里斯拒绝透露细节：“我不会给它设定时间表。我认为这会是那种，你知道，观望等待的事情。”
实际上，这一过程的某些部分是在最后一刻才凑齐的。布德科夫斯基在媒体会上透露，他甚至还没有时间好好参观工厂，而托里斯解释说，洛登在公开宣布的前一天上午才被告知。
“所以格拉姆和我今天上午谈过，所以我认为从那个角度看，这是一次非常近期的对话，”托里斯说，并补充说这不是一个“共同决定”。
据凯迪拉克称，当前成绩并未起作用。相反，一个考虑是，新车队领队在这个阶段仍能积极影响2027项目，而如果更晚更换领导层，这几乎不可能。
AI、沟通和通用汽车：为何需要变革
比时机更有趣的是，凯迪拉克为何认为车队下一阶段需要不同类型的领导，以及为何选择了布德科夫斯基。
尽管赛道上的竞争表现对一支新军来说相当令人鼓舞——甚至可能好于预期——但幕后仍有一些领域需要改进。其中包括工厂内部的沟通：防止车队内部形成孤岛，确保不同部门尽可能高效地协同工作。
托里斯认为，在这个新阶段，这支美国车队需要不同类型的领导
托里斯承认这些问题，并将其确定为车队新领导方向的关键焦点。
“很多这些问题，在不同程度上确实存在，我认为都是初创期的问题，”凯迪拉克的F1首席执行官认为。
“我认为在新组织中，沟通永远是需要改进的焦点，要确保事情组织得当、协调一致，并在建设阶段保持士气。所以这些问题是预料之中的，它们确实在不同程度上存在。”
除了人的因素，托里斯认为通用汽车内部仍有大量未开发的潜力。例如，这适用于人工智能以及通用汽车在该领域的工具。托里斯还认为，布德科夫斯基能比凯迪拉克迄今为止更好地利用这些资源。
当Autosport问及下一阶段他看重什么时，托里斯明确表示：“展望未来，我认为我们要的是一个拥有非常强大技术背景的车队领队的模式。我认为如果你看看马尔钦的背景、他在F1取得的成就，他肯定符合要求。”
“此外，我认为马尔钦离开F1的这段时间给了他一个视角，去审视F1如何演变和发展，审视通用汽车和TWG的资源，并真正思考一支F1车队的未来愿景可以是什么样。”
而正是在最后这一点上，AI开始发挥作用：“AI和这类事物的作用，我认为通过凯迪拉克，我们才刚刚触及通用汽车在F1所能提供的工具集的表面，所以我认为这方面还有更多工作要做。”
AI也是布德科夫斯基作为凯迪拉克车队老板首次亮相媒体时强调的要点之一。在他看来，未来的F1车队将与今天的团队大不相同。
“F1正在发生很多变化，同时社会也在发生巨大变化，AI正在接管很多事情，”他说。
“我认为它会进入F1，但我们正处于这一进程的非常非常初期。但我确实认为，未来的车队将与现在看起来大不相同。”
托里斯认为通用汽车的工具迄今尚未被充分利用
这与凯迪拉克将车队重心略微向美国转移的雄心相吻合。不是要从银石设施拿走什么，而是要利用美国本土的其他技术和专业知识。
“显然，由于F1人才集中在英国，我们的大部分招聘一直在英国进行，未来正进入一个更以美国为中心的阶段。这不是通过搬迁人员，而是通过在其他地点继续发展组织，”托里斯解释说。
“我们也在关注其他行业的创新能力。马尔钦提到了航空航天，还有其他一些行业。再者，就是进一步整合通用汽车可用的工具集。我们将审视所有这些事情，把它们整合到所有地点。”
除了围绕沟通的初创期问题，这将是布德科夫斯基最重要的任务之一。凯迪拉克认为，尽管车队仍处于起步阶段，但潜力被留在了桌面上，而布德科夫斯基需要为长远目标挖掘的正是通用汽车内部的这种潜力。
与此同时，这一举动表明，在F1没有人能稳坐职位，始终需要交出成绩——即使你正在从零开始组建一支F1车队，可能以为时间站在你这边。
布德科夫斯基必须平衡他的短期任务——尤其是解决凯迪拉克的可靠性问题——与为车队制定长期愿景
detailEn: Why Cadillac has decided to act now and replace Lowdon with Budkowski

Cadillac F1 CEO Dan Towriss says the team needs a different type of leadership for “a new phase”, but admits the change has come earlier than expected. So why does the American outfit believe it needs to act now?
More than a week before the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, the Formula 1 world was abruptly awakened from its summer break.
At 3pm UK time, Cadillac decided the time was right to make a shock announcement: Graeme Lowdon had been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski.

Two elements of that news are not particularly strange in themselves. For many in the paddock, it had already been clear for some time that while the well-liked Lowdon had been crucial during the team's initial build-up phase, he would not remain team principal in the longer term.

Nor is it particularly surprising that Cadillac has turned to someone like Budkowski. The French-educated Pole has gained experience across several different areas of F1: technical roles at the likes of Prost, Ferrari and McLaren, the regulatory side through his stint at the FIA, and subsequently the leadership side via his time at Alpine.
Cadillac admits it came earlier than planned
The main question is the timing: why now, and why so soon?

Cadillac stressed both in its press release and during the subsequent media session that it was a “planned transition”, but even then the timing is highly unusual. It comes in the middle of the summer break and only halfway through Cadillac's very first F1 season – extremely early, in other words.
"Anytime we're making a transition in Formula 1, as you guys know, it's very difficult," Towriss said, effectively concluding that there is no perfect moment for such an intervention.
That said, the 54-year-old American does admit that the intention was not to make the change this early. Yes, replacing Lowdon was part of the plan all along, but not necessarily at this point.
"Graeme and I always talked about that there would be a transition at some point," he continued. "This decision was mine and I think there's a very narrow window of opportunity.

"When you look at what we're building, there is an opportunity to build something new and innovative. What I didn't want to do was to build something that's already been done, something that's old and then try to improve it. So I think that the time for that change came sooner than was expected."
Cadillac admits that it was not a mutual decision and that Lowdon was only informed on the morning of the announcement
That naturally raises the question of when Cadillac had initially planned to replace Lowdon.

However, when Autosport asked whether the original idea had been to make the change at the end of the team's first season, Towriss declined to go into detail: "I wouldn't put a timetable on it. I think it was going to be, you know, a wait-and-see kind of thing."

In practice, some parts of the process came together at the last minute. Budkowski revealed during the media session that he had not even had the time for a proper factory tour yet, while Towriss explained that Lowdon was only informed on the morning before the public announcement.
"So Graeme and I spoke this morning, so I think it is a very recent conversation from that perspective," Towriss said, adding that it had not been a "mutual decision".

The current results did not play a role, according to Cadillac. Instead, one consideration was that a new team principal can still actively influence the 2027 project at this stage, whereas that would have been almost impossible with a later leadership change.
AI, communication and GM: why change is needed
Even more interesting than the timing is why Cadillac believes it needs a different type of leadership for the team's next phase, and why it has chosen Budkowski.

Although the competitive picture on track is fairly encouraging for a newcomer – perhaps even better than expected – there are areas behind the scenes that need improving. These include communication at the factory: preventing silos within the team and ensuring that the different departments work together as effectively as possible.
Towriss argues that, in this new phase, the American team needs a different kind of leadership
Towriss acknowledges those issues and identifies them as key focal points of the team's new leadership direction.
"A lot of those issues, which to different degrees do exist, I think are teething issues," Cadillac's F1 CEO reckoned.

"I think in new organisations, communication is always going to be a focal point to improve, making sure things are organised correctly, aligned correctly, and maintaining morale through that building phase. So those issues are to be expected, and they do exist in different degrees."

Aside from the human element, Towriss believes there is still plenty of untapped potential within General Motors. That applies, for example, to artificial intelligence and the tools GM has in that area. Towriss also believes Budkowski can make greater use of those resources than Cadillac has managed so far.

Asked by Autosport what he was looking at for the next stage, Towriss clarified: "As we look to the future, I think we’re looking at a model with a very strong technical team principal. And I think if you look at Marcin's background, what he's accomplished in Formula 1, he certainly fits the bill.

"Also, I think the time that Marcin has had away from Formula 1 provides him with a perspective to look at both how F1 has evolved and developed, look at the resources across General Motors and TWG, and really look at what a future vision of a Formula 1 team can look like."

And it is precisely on that final point that AI comes into play: "The role of AI and those kinds of things, I think we've only scratched the surface of the tool set that GM has to offer in F1 through Cadillac and so I think there's more work to be done there."
AI was also one of the points Budkowski emphasised during his first media appearance as Cadillac’s team boss. In his view, the F1 team of the future will look very different from today's squads.
"There's a lot of changes in F1 and then there's a huge societal change going on as well, with AI taking over a lot of things," he said.
"And I think it's coming to F1, but we're at the very, very beginning of that. But I do think the teams of the future will look very different from what they look now."
Towriss believes that GM’s tools have not been utilised to their full potential so far

This ties in with Cadillac’s ambition to shift the team's centre of gravity slightly more towards the United States. Not by taking anything away from the Silverstone facility, but by tapping into other technologies and expertise on American soil.

"Obviously, with the concentration of F1 talent in the UK, the bulk of our recruitment has been in the UK and is moving into a more US-centric phase going forward. That is not by moving people, but by continuing to grow the organisation in other locations," Towriss explained.

"We’re also looking at innovation capabilities from other industries. Marcin mentioned aerospace and there are some other industries as well. And again, further integration of the tool set available at GM. We'll be looking at all of those things, integrating those across all the locations."

Alongside the teething issues around communication, this will be one of Budkowski's most important tasks. Cadillac believes that, despite the team still being in its infancy, potential has been left on the table, and it is precisely that potential within GM that Budkowski needs to tap into for the longer term.

At the same time, the current move shows that nobody in F1 is safe in their job and that there is always a need to deliver – even when you are building an F1 team from scratch and might think you have time on your side.
Budkowski must balance his short-term tasks – particularly resolving Cadillac's reliability issues – with setting out a long-term vision for the team

detailZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监警告，F1车队不会对2027年下压力削减坐视不管
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年的下压力削减予以反击
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1向2026年新动力单元与底盘规则的过渡彻底打乱了竞争格局，但规则手册远未最终确定。随着车队为2027年新规下的第二个赛季做准备，国际汽联正推动再次强制降低下压力。
早期报告表明，管理机构的目标是在2027赛季将下压力减少20至50个点。为了实现这一目标，国际汽联计划禁止若干关键的后部空气动力学部件，以改善混合动力能量管理，并减少阻碍赛车紧密跟车的湍流“脏空气”。
但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森最近警告说，制定规则来减慢一级方程式赛车的速度，很少能阻止围场顶尖工程师找到绕过它的办法。
在NU Silver Arrows Radio Show播客节目中，艾利森确认了国际汽联拟议的空气动力学限制范围，同时向即将到来的研发战发出了挑战。
“我所知道的是，新规则会让赛车损失一些下压力，不止一点，”艾利森解释道。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队
从历史上看，国际汽联与一级方程式车队之间的关系始终是一场无休止的猫鼠游戏。管理机构出于安全和竞赛考量修改规则手册以限制过弯速度，而车队则立即在风洞中投入数百万美元，以恢复国际汽联试图削去的下压力。
据艾利森表示，2027年的规则周期也不会有任何不同。
“他们已经做出了不错的尝试，试图将下压力拉回到2026时代初期的水平，”艾利森指出。
他补充道：“看看各车队是会选择妥协接受，还是会全力夺回全部性能，这将非常有意思。”
如果梅赛德斯在2026年的巨大飞跃能说明什么，那就是阿利森在布拉克利的工程部门完全没有妥协的打算。2027赛季的技术战线已经正式划定。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director warns F1 teams won’t “lie down” over 2027 downforce cuts
Mercedes technical director James Allison warns F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's 2027 downforce cuts
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1's transition to the new 2026 engine and chassis regulations completely reshuffled the competitive order, but the rulebook is far from finalised. As teams prepare for their second year under the new formula in 2027, the FIA is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce.

Early reports indicate the governing body is targeting a reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce for the 2027 season. To achieve this, the FIA plans to ban several key rear aerodynamic elements in a bid to improve hybrid energy management and reduce the turbulent "dirty air" that prevents cars from following each other closely.
But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently cautioned that writing a rule to slow down a Formula 1 car rarely stops the grid's top engineers from finding a way around it.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Allison confirmed the scope of the FIA's proposed aerodynamic restrictions while simultaneously throwing down the gauntlet for the upcoming development war.
"All I know is that the cars are going to be losing a bit of downforce from the new regs, more than a bit," Allison explained.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Historically, the relationship between the FIA and Formula 1 constructors is a perpetual game of cat and mouse. The governing body alters the rulebook to limit cornering speeds on safety and racing grounds, and the teams immediately spend millions of dollars in the wind tunnel to recover the exact downforce the FIA attempted to take away.
According to Allison, the 2027 regulation cycle will be no different.
"They've had a good go at trying to pull the downforce back to [the] start of the 2026 era," Allison noted.
"It'll be interesting to see whether the teams lie down and take that or whether we recover it all or not," he added.

If Mercedes' massive leap forward in 2026 is any indication, Allison's engineering department in Brackley has zero intention of lying down. The technical battle lines for the 2027 season have officially been drawn.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
detailZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上推出阿迪达斯系列
梅赛德斯-奔驰霓虹灯和奥迪夜场系列现已通过adidas.com购买
拉斯维加斯欢迎标志上空出现彩虹
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪为即将到来的Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛推出了特别的阿迪达斯粉丝系列。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列名为"霓虹灯"，而奥迪的系列名为"深夜"。这两个系列现在已在adidas.com上上市，品牌美国店内的单品价格从30美元到200美元不等。
最贵的产品是外套。梅赛德斯-奔驰的拉斯维加斯夹克和奥迪的拉斯维加斯轰炸机夹克都售价200美元。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列比奥迪的大。除了夹克，它还包括120美元的卫衣、95美元的长袖T恤、60美元的短裤、55美元的车手帽、50美元的比赛帽和40美元及45美元的T恤。
奥迪车队的阵容有55美元的车手上限，两件各45美元的图形T恤和一件30美元的包。
两支车队抵达拉斯维加斯时的位置截然不同。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定了2026年 constructors' championship。奥迪在接管萨博后作为一支工厂车队的第一赛季，目前排名第八，积28分。这家德国车队落后哈斯三分。
梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。他的队友乔治·拉塞尔目前正在争夺亚军，目前排名第三，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格目前在车手积分榜上分别排名第14和第15，两人都积14分。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，是赛季最后三轮比赛中的第一轮，紧接着是卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
The Mercedes Neon Lights and Audi After Hours collections are available now through adidas.com
A rainbow above the Welcome to Las Vegas sign
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Mercedes and Audi have unveiled special adidas fan collections for the upcoming Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Mercedes' range is called "Neon Lights", while Audi's is named "After Hours". Both collections are available now through adidas.com, and the pieces listed on the brand's US store range in price from $30 to $200.
The most expensive items are the outerwear. Mercedes' Las Vegas jacket and Audi's Las Vegas bomber jacket both cost $200.
The Mercedes collection is the bigger of the two. Alongside the jacket, it includes a $120 hoodie, a $95 long-sleeve T-shirt, $60 shorts, a $55 driver cap, a $50 race cap and T-shirts at $40 and $45.
Audi's line-up has a $55 driver cap, two graphic T-shirts at $45 each and a $30 bag.

The two teams arrive in Las Vegas in very different positions. Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Audi, in its first season as a works team after taking over Sauber, currently sits eighth in the standings with 28 points. The German outfit is three points behind Haas.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of F1. His team-mate George Russell is currently in the fight for second in the championship, sitting third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg currently sit 14th and 15th in the drivers' standings, both on 14 points.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place from 19 to 21 November and is the first of the final three rounds of the season, ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

relatedItems.summaryZh: 四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，未来数年将参与该公司的传播与营销活动。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
relatedItems.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies, and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与荷兰技术集团VDK签任大使协议
这位红牛车手将在未来数年参与VDK的传播与营销活动
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，该集团正在向欧洲扩张。
这位荷兰车手将在未来几年在该公司的国际品牌推广中发挥重要作用，并将出现在其传播和营销活动中。
VDK 成立于 2013 年，是一家荷兰技术公司集团，如今在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时都有业务。
维斯塔潘表示，他认为 VDK 的组织方式与 F1 车队的运作方式有相似之处。
“VDK 的世界与一级方程式赛车之间有很多相似之处，”这位红牛车手说道。“技术发挥着巨大作用，但任何关注这项运动的人都知道，只有整个团队都达到顶尖水平，你才能发挥出最佳表现。”
在一支一级方程式车队里，每天都有大量的人在工作，让一切变得更好、更快。每个人都有自己的专业领域和职责。我在VDK的运作方式中看到了这一点。
它由许多技术公司和专业人士组成，他们各有专长，但团结在一起就更强大。VDK是一家创新型公司，也有着远大的国际雄心。我很高兴能在未来几年成为其中一员。
VDK创始人兼首席执行官弗兰斯·范德科尔克表示，这位荷兰人是公司下一步发展的理想人选。
“马克斯·维斯塔潘加入VDK集团让我无比自豪，”范德科尔克说。“马克斯多年来一直是世界上最顶尖的车手之一。但同样吸引我的是这背后的一切。仅靠天赋永远不够。你需要身边有优秀的人、相互信任、技术专长，以及每天变得更好的动力。这正是我在VDK集团所看到的。”
“我们通过整合实力雄厚的本地家族企业，并给予创业者自由发展的空间来实现增长。这一基础不会改变。与此同时，我们正日益将目光投向国门之外。”
“随着在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时拥有公司，我们正在形成一个日益国际化的集团。马克斯·维斯塔潘闻名世界，同时也体现了那种令人熟悉的荷兰务实态度和赢家心态。说实话，我无法想象还有谁比他更能代表我们希望带领VDK前进的方向。”
过去两年一直与VDK合作的前F1车手罗伯特·杜恩博斯将继续担任大使和演讲嘉宾。根据公告，他在协调与维斯塔潘的合作关系中发挥了关键作用。
“我非常高兴能与弗兰斯和VDK集团合作，”杜恩博斯解释道。“我们已经共同取得了伟大的成就，我也真正了解了VDK背后的人。如今我还能为这一下一步贡献力量，这让一切更加特别。”
“有了马克斯，VDK 集团当然就引进了一位真正独一档的人物。我很高兴我们现在为 VDK 集团携手合作，也非常期待未来的岁月。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
The Red Bull driver will feature in VDK’s communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies that is expanding across Europe.
The Dutchman will play a prominent role in the company's international branding over the coming years and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns.
VDK was founded in 2013 as a Dutch group of technical companies and now has businesses in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland and Belgium.
Verstappen said he saw parallels between the way VDK is organised and the way an F1 team works.

"There are many similarities between the world of VDK and Formula 1," the Red Bull driver said. "Technology plays a huge role, but anyone who follows the sport knows that you can only perform at your best if the entire team is top-notch.

"In a Formula 1 team, a huge number of people work every day to make everything better and faster. Everyone has their own area of specialisation and responsibility. I recognise that in the way VDK operates.

"It’s a group of many technical companies and professionals who all have their own expertise but are stronger together. VDK is an innovative company and also has major international ambitions. I’m excited to be a part of that in the coming years."
VDK founder and chief executive Frans van der Kolk said the Dutchman was the ideal fit for the company's next step.

"The fact that Max Verstappen is joining the VDK Group makes me incredibly proud," van der Kolk said. "Max has been among the absolute world’s best for years. But what appeals to me just as much is what lies behind that. Talent alone is never enough. You need good people around you, mutual trust, technical expertise, and the drive to get better every day. That’s exactly what I see in the VDK Group.

"We’ve grown by bringing together strong local and family-owned businesses and giving entrepreneurs the freedom to thrive. That foundation won’t change. At the same time, we’re looking beyond our borders with increasing focus.

"With companies in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland, and Belgium, we’re forming an increasingly international group. Max Verstappen is known worldwide and, at the same time, embodies that recognisable Dutch down-to-earth attitude and winner’s mentality. To be honest, I can’t imagine a stronger face to represent where we want to take VDK."

Former F1 driver Robert Doornbos, who has worked with VDK for the past two years, will stay on as an ambassador and speaker. According to the announcement, he played a key role in coordinating the partnership with Verstappen.

"I am very pleased with the collaboration with Frans and the VDK Group," Doornbos explained. "We’ve already achieved great things together, and I’ve really gotten to know the people behind VDK. The fact that I’ve now also been able to contribute to this next step makes it even more special.

"With Max, the VDK Group is, of course, bringing in someone who is truly in a league of his own. I’m happy that we’re now working together for the VDK Group and am really looking forward to the years ahead."
